claim_text: Pi extensions and custom tools can draw their own TUI components to build interactive interfaces inside the agent.
evidence_span: Extensions and custom tools can render custom TUI components for interactive user interfaces.

claim_text: Every line a Pi TUI component returns from render() must fit within the width parameter it was given.
evidence_span: **Critical:** Each line from `render()` must not exceed the `width` parameter.

claim_text: Pi's TUI appends a full SGR and OSC 8 reset to each rendered line, so styles never carry across lines and multi-line styled text must reapply them per line.
evidence_span: The TUI appends a full SGR reset and OSC 8 reset at the end of each rendered line. Styles do not carry across lines.

claim_text: A theme change makes Pi's TUI call invalidate() on every component to drop cached renders, so a component that does not implement it correctly will not pick the new theme up.
evidence_span: When the theme changes, the TUI calls `invalidate()` on all components to clear their caches. Components must properly implement `invalidate()` to ensure theme changes take effect.

claim_text: Pi's guidance is to reuse the built-in SelectList, SettingsList, and BorderedLoader components, which cover about 90% of extension UI cases, rather than rebuild them.
evidence_span: `SelectList`, `SettingsList`, `BorderedLoader` cover 90% of cases. Don't rebuild them.
